name: Wisdom of Agamaggan
summary: At Camp Taurajo, Mangletooth trades the wisdom of Agamaggan for blood shards. The captive quilboar offers Horde spellcasters a ritual drawn from the ancient boar god’s power.

sections.title: Blood Shards and Ancient Power
sections.body: At Camp Taurajo, Mangletooth is held prisoner by the Horde. The quilboar trades his people’s magical secrets for blood shards, crimson crystals said to have formed from Agamaggan’s spilled blood. The towering boar Demigod died in the War of the Ancients. Mangletooth says the geomancers and shaman of his tribes use the shards to channel divine power in their rituals.

sections.title: Blessing of the Mind
sections.body: Other shard offerings bring physical resilience or swiftness. Mangletooth’s Wisdom ritual instead sharpens intellect and arcane ability. For four blood shards, he calls on Agamaggan’s spirit to grant you cunning in your confrontations, then reminds you of your mortality.

faq.answer: Agamaggan is an ancient boar Demigod who fought the Burning Legion during the War of the Ancients ten thousand years ago. He fell in the Barrens, where his blood soaked the soil and gave rise to giant thorn vines and crystalline blood shards.

faq.q: Why is Mangletooth willing to help the Horde?
faq.answer: Mangletooth is a captive quilboar held in a cage at Camp Taurajo. Though his tribe fiercely hates the Horde, he values blood shards and his own survival more than loyalty, and gives sacred tribal blessings in exchange for shards.
Blood shards are red mineral formations found throughout quilboar lands in the Barrens. Quilboar legend says the crystals formed from drops of blood shed by Agamaggan as he died.

faq.q: Can I repeat this ritual more than once?
faq.answer: Yes. After you first show Mangletooth blood shards and earn his trust, he accepts four at a time whenever you want to renew the blessing.

faq.q: Do quilboar shaman worship other deities?
faq.answer: Quilboar revere Agamaggan above all others and believe they descend directly from him. Their shamans and geomancers draw nature magic and power over the earth from his legacy and remnants.

faq.q: Where does Mangletooth suggest our next meeting might be?
faq.answer: After the ritual, Mangletooth asks you to share tales of your cunning the next time you meet, whether in this life or the next. His words acknowledge the ceaseless bloodshed across the Barrens.

angles.text: At Camp Taurajo, the Horde keeps Mangletooth captive, giving you a chance to draw on native Barrens magic against the quilboar tribes.
As a mage, you can recognize how Agamaggan’s essence channels primal geomantic power into raw intellect.
As a priest, you may find the link between Agamaggan’s divine blood and rituals that fortify the mind an intriguing part of primal worship.
As a shaman, you may recognize how quilboar geomancy echoes elemental callings, while the boar god’s shard rituals remain uniquely wild.
